中文释义: n. 乞丐　vt. 使沦为乞丐（beggar description 无法形容）
原文例句: I must say, I like to serve a decayed gentleman better than a blarnerying beggar.
例句译文: “我得说，我宁愿服侍一位破落的绅士，也不愿伺候一个爱吹牛的乞丐。”

中文释义: a. 恶意的，恶毒的（with malicious glee 不怀好意地）
原文例句:
Amy caught herself up short as the words escaped her, and looked at her husband, who replied, with malicious gravity . . .	艾米话一出口便赶紧收住，看了看丈夫，而他带着一脸恶作剧般的坏笑答道……	little_women Ch44
zeal	zi:l	—	n. 热忱，热情（with zeal 满腔热忱）	C1	He went at the work with a zeal that surprised everyone.	他干起活来那股热劲儿让所有人都惊讶。	little_women Ch44

accumulate	ә'kju:mjuleit	verb	v. 积累，积聚（let money accumulate 让钱堆着）	C1	Rich people have no right to sit down and enjoy themselves, or let their money accumulate for others to waste.
例句译文: “有钱人没有权利坐着享清福，也没有权利让钱白白堆着，留给别人去糟蹋。”

中文释义: a. 稳定的；稳重的（keep me steady 让我沉住气）
原文例句: I need something of the sort to keep me steady.
例句译文: “我需要点这类东西，好让自己稳住心神。”

中文释义: n. 震惊；冲击（a shock to）　v. 使震惊
原文例句: The news came as a great shock to the whole family.
例句译文: 这个消息让全家都大为震惊。

中文释义: a. 文学的，文人的（a literary husband 文人丈夫）
原文例句: She won't think so when she has a literary husband, and a dozen little professors and professorins to support.
例句译文: “等她有了个文人的丈夫，还有一小群要养的小教授们，她就不会这么想了。”

中文释义: n. 钦佩，赞赏（in admiration 赞叹地）
原文例句: I suppose it's wrong, but I do, though it is harder." "Because it takes a gentleman to do it," added the other member of the domestic admiration society.
例句译文: “我觉得这样不对，可我就是佩服他，虽然更难。”“因为那要一个正人君子才做得到。”另一位也附和道。

中文释义: v. 过日子，进展（fare badly 境遇不好）　n. 票价；饮食
原文例句: Out-and-out beggars get taken care of, but poor gentle folks fare badly, because they won't ask, and people don't dare to offer charity.
例句译文: 彻头彻尾的乞丐倒有人照应，可怜的体面人却境遇凄惨，因为他们不肯开口求人，而人们又不会主动……

中文释义: a. 偶尔的，间或的（an occasional 偶尔一次的）
原文例句:
Exactly, for Amy keeps me pointing due west most of the time, with only an occasional whiffle round to the south, and I haven't had an easterly spell since I was married.	“正是如此，艾米总让我朝正西走，只是偶尔打个转儿，偏到南边去……”	little_women Ch44
mansion	'mænʃәn	—	n. 大厦，宅邸（the great mansion 大宅）	B2	The great mansion stood empty at the end of the avenue.	大道尽头，那座大宅空置着。	little_women Ch44
gravity	'græviti	noun	n. 严肃，庄重（with gravity 一本正经地）；重力	B2	 Amy caught herself up short as the words escaped her, and looked at her husband, who replied, with malicious gravity . . .
例句译文: 艾米话一出口便赶紧收住，看了看丈夫，而他一本正经地坏笑着答道……

中文释义: v. 干涉，干预（interfere with 妨碍）
原文例句: We won't interfere now, but watch our chance, and do them a good turn in spite of themselves.
例句译文: “我们现在不插手，只留意机会，到时候帮他们一把，哪怕他们自己不领情。”

中文释义: n. 斗篷，外套　v. 掩盖，掩饰（under the cloak of）
原文例句: What are you going to do with yourselves after you get settled? asked Jo, buttoning Amy's cloak as she used to button her pinafores.
例句译文: “安顿下来以后，你们打算做些什么？”乔问道，一边照旧替艾米扣好斗篷……
